name: smepost-marketing-workdesk
description: Plan social content and manage SMEPost projects, folders, designs, and versions from your AI host.

interface.longDescription:
Create social media posts, AI images and captions in ChatGPT, then save and manage them in SMEPost.

Turn a campaign idea, product details or an uploaded image into social content. Ask ChatGPT to create or edit an image and write Instagram captions, Facebook post copy, LinkedIn posts or Threads captions. Save your images and copy to SMEPost projects and folders, and use authorized brand knowledge to keep your content on-brand.

Open SMEPost beside your conversation to compare social media previews, edit captions, download images and review version history. Save an edited image as a new version of the same design while keeping the original. You can also upload a PNG, JPEG or WebP from your device, up to 4 MiB per image.

Connect a SMEPost account and choose an organization you can access. Native image generation and editing use the capabilities available in ChatGPT. In other AI hosts, use an available image capability or a supplied image. Importing images does not require an OpenAI API key or use SMEPost image-generation credits. Publishing and scheduling continue through an explicitly approved handoff to the SMEPost website.
defaultPrompt: Create an Instagram post with an image and caption, and save it to SMEPost.
Edit a saved social media image and keep the original in SMEPost.
Show my SMEPost designs and preview them for Instagram and LinkedIn.

positive.prompt: Open my SMEPost Workdesk and show my projects.
positive.expected_behavior: Authenticate when needed, show authorized organizations and projects, and open Workdesk beside the conversation.

positive.prompt: In my SMEPost demo organization, create a Weekend Coffee Campaign project and an Instagram folder.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the selected authorized organization and confirm the saved project and folder after successful tool results.

positive.description: Save a supplied or generated image
positive.prompt: Save this image to my SMEPost Coffee Launch project, in the Instagram folder, as Coffee Poster.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the host file object to save a valid image privately as a design, without SMEPost generation credits; reject unavailable or oversized files.

positive.prompt: Save this edited navy-cup image as a new version of my Coffee Latte design in SMEPost Coffee Launch. Keep the previous image in its history.
positive.expected_behavior: Save the attached edited image as a new version of the named existing Coffee Latte design through import_asset_file, preserving its prior version. If the current reply cannot access SMEPost write tools, direct the user to select the SMEPost App or use Workdesk's version-menu save action. Do not claim an edit was performed, expose internal IDs, file paths, raw JSON, or technical import instructions, or promise automatic tool resumption. Confirm the version only after a successful save.

positive.prompt: Save this Instagram caption to my Coffee Latte design in SMEPost Coffee Launch: Fresh coffee, a bright start. #Coffee. Then show the post preview.
positive.expected_behavior: Save the caption to the linked design chat and show the preview. Do not publish or schedule.

negative.prompt: What is the capital of France?
Write a Python function that sorts a list of numbers.
Give me three generic coffee caption ideas. Do not open or save anything in SMEPost.

zh-HK.subtitle: AI 社交媒體帖文及圖片創作
zh-HK.description:
喺 ChatGPT 用 AI 創作社交媒體帖文、圖片同 IG 文案，再存入 SMEPost 管理。

由推廣概念、產品資料或現有圖片開始，請 ChatGPT 出圖、改圖，或者撰寫 Instagram、Facebook、LinkedIn 同 Threads 文案。用 SMEPost 項目同資料夾整理內容，並套用已授權嘅品牌資料。

工作區會開喺對話旁邊，可以預覽不同社交媒體平台嘅帖文、修改文案、下載圖片同查看歷史版本。修改後嘅圖片可以存返同一個設計，原圖亦會保留；亦支援上傳每張最多 4 MiB 嘅 PNG、JPEG 或 WebP。

使用前請連接 SMEPost 帳戶。ChatGPT 出圖同改圖會使用 ChatGPT 本身可用嘅功能，匯入圖片唔需要 OpenAI API key，亦唔會扣 SMEPost 圖片生成 credits。其他 AI 應用程式則需使用可用嘅出圖功能，或者自行提供圖片。發佈同排程會喺你同意後返回 SMEPost 網站繼續。

zh-TW.subtitle: AI 社群貼文、圖片與文案
zh-TW.description:
在 ChatGPT 製作社群貼文、AI 圖片與 Instagram 文案，並將成果保存到 SMEPost。

把活動構想、產品資訊或圖片交給 ChatGPT，從視覺設計、改圖到 Facebook、LinkedIn 或 Threads 文案一起完成。透過專案與資料夾整理素材，並使用已授權的品牌知識，維持一致的品牌語調。

在對話旁開啟工作區，檢視各平台的貼文預覽、調整文案、下載圖片與比較歷史版本。每次改圖都可另存為同一設計的新版本，保留原始圖片。也能上傳每張不超過 4 MiB 的 PNG、JPEG 或 WebP。

需連結 SMEPost 帳戶。圖片生成與編輯依 ChatGPT 可用的功能執行；匯入圖片不需要 OpenAI API key，也不消耗 SMEPost 圖片生成額度。其他 AI 應用程式需使用可用的圖像功能或提供圖片。發佈及排程會在你同意後前往 SMEPost 網站繼續。

zh-CN.subtitle: AI 社交媒体帖子与图片创作
zh-CN.description:
在 ChatGPT 中创作社交媒体帖子、AI 图片和 Instagram 文案，把完成的内容保存到 SMEPost。

从营销活动想法、产品资料或现有图片开始，让 ChatGPT 生成或编辑图片，并编写适合 Facebook、LinkedIn、Threads 等渠道的文案。用项目和文件夹整理素材，结合已授权的品牌资料保持内容风格一致。

在聊天旁查看工作区，可切换不同平台的帖子预览、编辑文案、下载图片并查看版本记录。编辑后的图片可保存为同一设计的新版本，旧图继续保留。支持上传单张不超过 4 MiB 的 PNG、JPEG 或 WebP。

需关联 SMEPost 账号。图片生成和编辑取决于 ChatGPT 当前提供的功能；导入图片无需 OpenAI API key，也不会消耗 SMEPost 图片生成额度。其他 AI 应用需使用可用的图片功能或自行提供图片。发布与定时发布将在你确认后转到 SMEPost 网站继续。

publication.release_notes: Initial Workdesk release with authorized project and folder management, private image imports, preserved design versions, captions, social previews, and a ChatGPT thread side panel.
